parameters.question: Compare per-column median imputation reports: per-column missing counts must be exact; missing percentages within +/-0.05; median values within 1% relative absolute error; row and column order may differ.

Replace missing values in all numeric columns with their column medians. Compare the imputed tables record by record: every numeric value must be within 1% relative absolute error of the reference. Row order, column order and header labels may differ.
